page.overview:
What is Space Port?

Space Port is a LEGO Town subtheme which is centered around spaceflight. It was introduced in 1999, and succeeded the Launch Command theme from 1995 to 1997. Space Port featured a greater number of sets, and a greater diversity of vehicles than Launch Command.

According to DK Readers: LEGO Rocket Rescue, BB won a competition and got to be trained as an astronaut to go to Mars, with Life on Mars being a continuation of this.

The following minifigures were introduced in this theme. Like many other themes from the 1990s, these characters have different names in different regions and publications.
